payload.text: D-ADR0054: RUL11 (tùm lum, not heavy) gathers within the scope of the work in hand -- gather until done inside that scope; tùm lum seen outside it becomes its own item; supersedes D-ADR0036 (docs/platform/platform-foundations.md).
